sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block 
.
المواصفات الفنية

This document initiated by eng. El-Saeid Mohamed 
 Matarid, tested by eng. Ashraf Kamal El-Din Otba, reviewed by eng. Reda Ragab 
 Karam, approved by eng. Hamdy Ahmed Dorgham general director, accepted by eng. 
 Maamoun Abou El-Magd Atta Allah head sector of Damanhour Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona El-Sharkawy 
 WEDCO. inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.
The motor must be out of service.
Circuit breaker in test position.

العمل الذي يتعين القيام به
Clean air - ducts
Ensure that all fixing bolts are secured .
Ensure that electrical connection are tightened .
Check the isolators and clean it .
Check the oil level
Check operation of the motor from local and remote operation on test position.
Measure winding insulation resistance.
Check all protection devices of the motor by protection group.
